items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: He’s a saxophone player/composer/arranger. He has a band. He’s been doing Frank Zappa music for decades.

ctx.x: He’s a saxophone player/composer/arranger. He has a band. He’s been doing Frank Zappa music for decades. And he’s a really good musician. So I know that there’s something there that I’m missing but I don’t know what it is.
When you sit down, after you’ve practiced your saxophone and— do you have to be in a mood to compose?
